name: Hiecise Precision Equipment Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hiecise Precision Equipment Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and support service of high-end precision grinding equipment in China and internationally. The company offers CNC roll grinding machines, submicron-level high-end composite grinding products, precision thread grinding machines, precision CNC linear guide grinding machines, and ultra-precision CNC surface grinding machines, repair and renovation services; and spare parts. It also provides roll and cylindrical grinders for applications steel industry, nonferrous metal, papermaking, light skill textile, and equipment manufacturing industries.
